scope: Owner-requested Evo 2 DNA-sequence sensitivity comparison, fixed before model scores
runtime: Evo 2 0.6.0, Vortex 1.1.0, torch 2.6.0+cu124, FlashAttention 2.8.0.post2; 7B supported BF16, 40B required Transformer Engine FP8; no approximate kernel override
benchmark: Public Findlay 2018 BRCA1 saturation genome editing table and public GRCh37 chr17 distributed with official Evo2 notebook
selection: Exclude intermediate/non-SNV; sort SHA256(20260920:BRCA1:position:REF>ALT); choose first 48 FUNC and 48 LOF with at most one alternate per genomic site across both classes
score: mean autoregressive log likelihood alternate minus reference, no BOS; retain forward and reverse-complement scores separately and their average; same as upstream mean-reduction method
numerical_gate: Official built-in forward-test mean loss within 0.001 of checkpoint expected value; repeat reference score difference <=0.000001; finite outputs required. Stop runtime if numerical gate fails.
functional_gate: Descriptive BRCA1 AUROC using negative mean-strand delta >=0.70 and LOF median delta lower than FUNC; this is a resource qualification, not clinical validation or a gene-transfer guarantee
candidate_inference: Diagnostic outputs retained for both prespecified models even if functional gate fails; no candidate inference on a failed numerical gate. No selecting passing models, windows or strands after seeing results.
candidate_source: Permitted ranked-pair report notes/track2-report-v12.md; no VCF access
reference_source: Public Ensembl REST GRCh38 forward-strand sequence; REF/length/alphabet checks before transfer; alternate is synthetic
limitations: Reference DNA not a subject haplotype; phase cannot be inferred
BRCA1 benchmark cannot establish BUB1B accuracy; benchmark/pretraining overlap is unknown
Whole-window scores are context/strand/model-dependent and do not measure splicing, NMD, protein function, drug response or clinical probabilities
Model scales are correlated comparisons, not independent genetic evidence or biological replication
No generation, genome editing, biological material or treatment action
